title: DiffSFTMetadata
description: Sediment evidence for one diff-SFT sample.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

repo.description: `owner/repo`, lowercased. Empty string when the sender omitted it.

source_model.description: The model that served the source inference call.

completion_id.description: The inference call that supplied the training target.

recipe_id.description: The closed evidence recipe that produced this training row.

recipe_version.description: The version of the evidence recipe; increment it when recipe semantics change.

eligibility_source.description: The closed evidence source that made this supervised target eligible.

label_confidence.description: Trust in the derived training label, bounded to [0, 1].

ci_reliability.description: Trust in the resolved CI evidence, separate from the categorical label.

provenance.description: The structured provenance for this artifact.

split.description: Which side of the deterministic eval split this row is on, hashed on `session_id` so a session never straddles both.

source_ids.description: The facts this row was assembled from.

schema_id.description: The canonical wire-shape contract for this row.

schema_version.description: The positive integer version of the canonical row schema.

quarantine_revision.description: The integer quarantine-log high-water mark used for the derivation.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 of the fully resolved derivation policy when available.

inference_call_id.description: Id of the inference call this record belongs to.

decision_ids.description: Decisions that contributed to the row.

ci_outcome_ids.description: CI outcomes that contributed to the row.
